language.label: Language
language.hint: Choose the language for the interface. Changes take effect immediately.
settings.title: Settings
settings.download.hint: Images dragged in from a web page, or downloaded with the browser extension's right-click menu, are saved to the folder you currently have open in Tessera. When you download from a page that isn't a folder, such as “{all}”, they are saved to the folder below.
settings.download.notChosen: Not chosen yet (you'll be asked to pick one the first time you download)
settings.download.changeFailed: Couldn't change the download folder. Please try again.
settings.maintenance.hint: If you delete or move images on your computer, Tessera still keeps their records. Here you can find such images and clean them up once you confirm. Cleaning only removes records and thumbnails from the library; no files are deleted.
settings.maintenance.lost_one: {count} image's original file no longer exists
settings.maintenance.lost_other: {count} images' original files no longer exist
settings.maintenance.lostHint: Their folders still exist, so the files were probably deleted or renamed.
settings.maintenance.unreachable_one: {count} image is in a folder that can't be found
settings.maintenance.unreachable_other: {count} images are in folders that can't be found
settings.maintenance.unreachableHint: An external drive or network drive may be disconnected, or the folder may have been moved. Make sure the device is connected before deciding whether to remove them.
sidebar.tagsEmpty: No tags yet. Add them with an image's “Tag” action or in its “Info” panel.
layout.title: Image layout
sort.by.name: File name
smart.subtitle: Images that match will be added automatically, including images you add later.
smart.name: Name
smart.conditionsHint: All the conditions you fill in must be met. Leave a field empty for no limit.
smart.days: Taken within the last… (by date taken)
smart.tagsPlaceholder: No limit; separate tags with commas or semicolons
smart.tagsHint: An image is included if it has any one of these tags. Tags that don't exist are ignored.
smart.droppedTags: Tag(s) “{tags}” don't exist and were ignored
smart.error.createFailed: Couldn't create it. Please check the name and conditions.
smart.error.createFailedRetry: Couldn't create it. Please try again.
toast.downloadDesktopOnly: Downloading is only available in the desktop app
toast.downloadError: Download error. Please try again later.
toast.smartDesktopOnly: Smart collections are only available in the desktop app
error.apiMissing: This feature isn't available yet: please fully quit and restart the app
gallery.empty.title: Your library is empty
gallery.empty.hint: Click the button below to add your first images
duplicate.desc: Detected automatically from image content and pHash. You can choose to keep the best photo.
detail.fileMissing: The original file is missing (it may have been deleted or moved), so a thumbnail is shown. You can clean up such images in “{settings} → {maintenance}”.
detail.noExif: This image has no EXIF data
detail.openWithViewer: Open with the system image viewer
detail.copiedPath: Copied the file path (this format can't be copied as an image)
tag.title: Tags
tag.existingMany: Existing tags (click × to remove from all these images)
tag.addPlaceholder: Type a tag and press Enter
tag.addFailedMissing: Couldn't add the tag. The images may have been deleted.
import.title: Import images to library
import.intro: Choose the images or folders to import. Images are indexed in the background, so you can search, organize and manage them right away.
import.chooseFilesHint: Supports JPG, PNG, HEIC, RAW and more
import.chooseFolderHint: Import every image in a folder at once
import.modeLabel: Import method (also used for images downloaded from web pages)
import.mode.referenceHint: Files aren't moved; they stay where they are
import.mode.copyHint: Files are copied into the library folder and managed there
import.watchHint: New images are added to the library automatically (folders only)
move.title: Move to folder
move.intro_one: The original file of {count} image will be moved to the folder you choose. This changes where it is on your computer. Files with the same name are renamed automatically and never overwritten.
move.intro_other: The original files of {count} images will be moved to the folder you choose. This changes where they are on your computer. Files with the same name are renamed automatically and never overwritten.
move.note.managed_one: {count} image was imported with “{mode}”. Its file is managed by the library and won't be moved.
move.note.managed_other: {count} images were imported with “{mode}”. Their files are managed by the library and won't be moved.
move.note.missing_one: {count} image's original file no longer exists and will be skipped
move.note.missing_other: {count} images' original files no longer exist and will be skipped
drop.desktopOnly: Drag-and-drop import is only available in the desktop app
drop.importError: Import error. Please try again later.
